unresolved.question: Every band ২ on this page (rows 0, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9) sits over a noon sakin or tanween before an ikhfa letter (س, ك, ت), not over a madd; labelled with this page's legend text for ২ (দম ফেলিলে দুই আলিফ) anyway.
Row 0: the waqf sign over the 95:4 verse circle is a small ز (mujawwaz); encoded as the closest available sign ۚ.
Row 0: the mark over فِيْۤ is a sukun wedge with a bar on top; written as sukun plus maddah.
Row 1 and others: the shadda over ص in الصّٰلِحٰتِ shows no clear standing alif at scan resolution; written in the usual Indo-Pak spelling الصّٰلِحٰتِ.
Row 2: ruku sign ع beside the 95:8 verse circle is skipped.
Row 8: the waqf sign after يَنْتَهِ is a small لا with a small mark under it; encoded as ۙ.
Row 8: لَنَسْفَعًا carries fathatan with a small meem (iqlab); written as لَنَسْفَعًۢا.

Ambiguous anchors: row 0 band ১ over سٰفِلِيْنَ sits between ف and س (anchored to سٰ); row 6 band ১ over يَنْهٰى sits between ه and ى (anchored to هٰ); row 7 band ১ over كَانَ sits between ك and ا (anchored to ا).
